name: client
//version: Deliberately left at 0.0.0 and never bumped: this package is private and never published, and the running version of the product is declared once, by the repository root package.json. One place to bump means two version strings in this repository can never disagree about which build is running.
author: Christian Mariani

scripts.lint: oxlint && npm run lint:ui-boundary && npm run lint:check-budgets
scripts.//lint:check-budgets: No skip and no exception marker, on purpose: a step allowed more patience than the test that runs it can never fail with its own message, so it is repaired rather than exempted. The tree to scan is an argument, so the check that drives this guard can point it at sources of its own instead of leaving a fixture spec where Playwright would run it.
scripts.test: npm run test:typecheck && npm run lint:ui-boundary && npm run lint:check-budgets && npm run test:unit
